name: CF Tone
description: Test-signal generator for A/B measurements over USB (tools/ua_ab.py): replaces the guitar with a fixed 12 s program (0.5 s silence, 1 s tones 82/110/220/440/880/1760/3520 Hz, 0.5 s silence, 4 s log sweep 40 Hz-16 kHz), repeating from the moment the patch loads. Put it in slot 1.

params.name: Level
params.explanation: Tone peak level, 0..0.5 of full scale (25 = 0.125, about -18 dBFS: guitar level).
